plan.title: A Note-Taking App That Keeps Your Ideas Findable
plan.description: A launch video for a new note-taking app that helps you capture ideas fast, organize them without effort, and find them again in seconds. See how it works in three simple steps.

beats.narration: You had a great idea yesterday. Where is it now? Buried in a text to yourself, a sticky note, or a notebook you left at home.
Scattered notes cost you time. You search several apps, scroll through old messages, and still miss the one thing you needed. Good ideas are only useful if you can find them.
So we built a note-taking app with one promise: capture an idea quickly, and find it again just as fast.

props.text: Capture in seconds. Find in seconds.

beats.narration: It works in a few simple steps. First, capture: open the app and start typing. Second, organize: keep your notes in order. Third, find: search for the note you need.
Capture is fast. There is no setup and no blank page to fear. You open the app, and the cursor is already waiting for your thought.
Organizing should not be a chore. Add a tag to group related thoughts. Keep your focus on the work.
Finding is the real test. Type a word you remember, and find matching notes. No digging, no guessing, no scrolling through old lists.
Your notes are ready when you need them. Start a thought at your desk, add to it while you walk, and pick it up again later.

clip_queries: commuters on a train with phones
props.alt: woman walking with smartphone in city

beats.narration: Built to stay out of your way.
Your best ideas deserve a home. Try the app today, and the next time a thought strikes, you will know exactly where it lives and how to get it back.

props.title: Never lose an idea again
props.subtitle: Capture it. Organize it. Find it.
